name: Official Aphel catalog
description: Business templates and extensions maintained in the Aphel repository. Community contributions come in through pull requests (see catalog/README.md).

entries.name: Vendas B2B
entries.description: Funil consultivo para vender a outras empresas: qualificação, demonstração, proposta e negociação, com segmento, porte e faturamento das contas e indicadores de conversão.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: B2B Sales
entries.description: Consultative pipeline for selling to other businesses: qualification, demo, proposal and negotiation, with account industry, size and revenue, plus conversion metrics.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Agência
entries.description: Para agências de marketing, design e desenvolvimento: novos projetos e renovações de contrato em funis separados, com escopo, serviços contratados, fee mensal e atividades de briefing e apresentação.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Agency
entries.description: For marketing, design and development agencies: new projects and contract renewals in separate pipelines, with scope, contracted services, monthly retainer, and briefing and presentation activities.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Freelancer
entries.description: Funil enxuto para quem trabalha sozinho: do primeiro contato ao orçamento aprovado, com valor/hora, horas estimadas, prazo de entrega e condição de pagamento.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Freelancer
entries.description: A lean pipeline for solo professionals: from first contact to approved quote, with hourly rate, estimated hours, delivery deadline and payment terms.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Imobiliária
entries.description: Para imobiliárias e corretores: funis de venda e de locação, dados do imóvel, campos de locação que só aparecem quando o negócio é locação, visitas, vistorias e etiquetas de perfil do cliente.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: Real Estate
entries.description: For real estate agencies and agents: sales and rental pipelines, property details, rental fields that only appear when the deal is a rental, showings, inspections and client profile tags.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: SaaS
entries.description: Para empresas de software por assinatura: do trial à assinatura fechada, com plano, MRR, número de usuários, fim do trial e data de renovação.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: SaaS
entries.description: For subscription software organizations: from trial to closed subscription, with plan, MRR, number of seats, trial end and renewal date.
entries.author: Aphel

entries.name: AI assistant
entries.description: Summaries, next-step suggestions, a writing assistant and natural language queries with a configurable AI provider
entries.author: Aphel

module.install_notes: Já incluído no build padrão (back/aphel.modules.toml). Para um build enxuto, mantenha a linha `ai` nesse arquivo, rode make modules, compile e habilite em Configurações > Módulos.

entries.name: CNPJ enrichment
entries.description: Looks up public company data by CNPJ (BrasilAPI and ReceitaWS) and fills the chosen fields, recording the source of each value. Always triggered manually unless the automation is enabled
entries.author: Aphel

module.install_notes: Já incluído no build padrão (back/aphel.modules.toml). Para um build enxuto, mantenha a linha `enrichment` nesse arquivo, rode make modules, compile e habilite em Configurações > Módulos.

entries.name: Electronic signature
entries.description: Sends PDFs attached to deals for electronic signature on Clicksign and tracks their status through webhooks. It has no legal validity of its own: validity comes from the provider
entries.author: Aphel

module.install_notes: Já incluído no build padrão (back/aphel.modules.toml). Para um build enxuto, mantenha a linha `esign` nesse arquivo, rode make modules, compile e habilite em Configurações > Módulos.
